en.s: The Peace of Bautzen (German: Frieden von Bautzen; Polish: Pokój w Budziszynie; Upper Sorbian: Budyski měr) was a treaty concluded on 30 January 1018, between Holy Roman Emperor Henry II and Bolesław I of Poland which ended a series of Polish-German wars over the control of Lusatia and Upper Lusatia (Milzenerland or Milsko, the eastern part of the margraviate of Meissen (Miśnia)) as well as Bohemia, Moravia and Slovakia.

zh.s: 包岑和约（德语：Frieden von Bautzen；波兰语：Pokój w Budziszynie；上索布语：Budyski měr）于1018年1月30日签订。神圣罗马帝国皇帝亨利二世与波兰的波列斯瓦夫一世签署和约，结束了双方为争夺卢萨蒂亚、上卢萨蒂亚（米尔泽纳兰或米尔斯科，即迈森边区东部）以及波希米亚、摩拉维亚和斯洛伐克而进行的一系列波兰—德国战争。

en.t: Wareru declares himself king of Martaban
en.s: On 30 January 1287, Wareru declared himself king of Martaban, in present-day Myanmar. His realm later became known as the Hanthawaddy Kingdom after its capital moved to Pegu; his coronation followed in April 1287.
en.n: The date follows the cited conversion from the Burmese calendar. The January declaration is distinct from the later coronation and relocation of the capital.

zh.s: 1287年1月30日，伐丽流在今缅甸马达班称王，加冕仪式于同年4月举行。其王国后来迁都勃固，才被称为勃固王国。
zh.n: 此日期采用所引资料对缅历的换算；1月称王、后来加冕和迁都不是同一件事。

en.s: The capture of Cairo was the final major engagement of the Ottoman Mamluk War of 1516-1517. The city of Cairo, the capital of the Mamluk Sultanate, was sacked and fell into the hands of the Ottoman forces led by Sultan Selim I during the 27-30 January 1517. Following Cairo's fall and the subsequent execution of the last Mamluk Sultan and member of the Abbasid dynasty: Tuman Bay II, the Mamluk Sultanate was absorbed into the expanding Ottoman Empire.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 攻占开罗是1516至1517年奥斯曼—马穆鲁克战争中的最后一场重大战役。1517年1月27日至30日，马穆鲁克苏丹国首都开罗遭洗劫，随后被苏丹塞利姆一世率领的奥斯曼军队占领。开罗陷落后，末代马穆鲁克苏丹、阿拔斯王朝后裔图曼贝伊二世被处决，马穆鲁克苏丹国也并入不断扩张的奥斯曼帝国。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Floods devastate the Bristol Channel coast
en.s: On 30 January 1607 in the Gregorian calendar, severe flooding struck the Bristol Channel and Severn Estuary coasts in present-day United Kingdom, inundating low-lying parts of southwest England and south Wales.
en.n: January 30 is the Gregorian date. Contemporary English records used January 20, 1606/07 in the Julian calendar with the year beginning in March.

zh.t: 布里斯托尔湾沿岸遭遇严重洪灾
zh.s: 公历1607年1月30日，今英国布里斯托尔湾和塞文河口沿岸发生严重洪灾，英格兰西南部与威尔士南部的多处低地被淹。
zh.n: 1月30日为公历日期；当时英国记录采用儒略历，并以3月为岁首，记作1606/07年1月20日。

en.s: The Battle of Okhmativ or Battle of Ochmatów (Polish: Ochmatów) of 30 January 1644 refers to the engagement between the Polish forces under hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and the horde of Crimean Tatars under Toğay bey. Koniecpolski dealt a crushing defeat to Toğay bey's forces near Okhmativ. This was the greatest Polish victory over the Tatars in the first half of the 17th century, and brought international fame and recognition to Koniecpolski.

zh.s: 1644年1月30日，盖特曼斯坦尼斯瓦夫·科涅茨波尔斯基指挥的波兰军队，与图盖贝伊率领的克里米亚鞑靼军在奥赫马蒂夫附近交战。科涅茨波尔斯基重创图盖贝伊的军队。这是17世纪上半叶波兰对鞑靼人取得的最大胜利，也使科涅茨波尔斯基在国际上声名远扬。

en.t: Spain and the Dutch Republic agree the Peace of Münster
en.s: On 30 January 1648, Spanish and Dutch representatives agreed and signed the Peace of Münster in Münster, in present-day Germany. Spain recognized Dutch independence, ending the Eighty Years’ War. Ratification followed later.
en.n: This is the January agreement/signature, not the later May ratification or October treaties at Münster and Osnabrück.

zh.t: 西班牙与荷兰共和国签订《明斯特和约》
zh.s: 1648年1月30日，西班牙与荷兰代表在今德国明斯特达成并签署和约，西班牙承认荷兰独立，八十年战争由此结束。条约的批准程序随后完成。
zh.n: 此条记录1月的达成与签署，区别于5月的批准，以及10月在明斯特和奥斯纳布吕克签订的其他条约。

en.t: Execution of Charles I of England
en.s: Charles I, King of England, Scotland and Ireland, was publicly executed on 30 January 1649 outside the Banqueting House on Whitehall, London. The execution was the culmination of political and military conflicts between the royalists and the parliamentarians in England during the English Civil War, leading to Charles's capture and his trial.

zh.t: 英格兰国王查理一世被处决
zh.s: 1649年1月30日，英格兰、苏格兰和爱尔兰国王查理一世在伦敦白厅宴会厅外公开处决。这场处决是英国内战期间王党与议会派政治和军事冲突的最终结果；查理一世因此被俘并接受审判。

en.t: The Truce of Andrusovo is signed, ending the Russian-Polish War of 1654-1667
en.s: The Truce of Andrusovo (Polish: Rozejm w Andruszowie, Russian: Андрусовское перемирие Andrusovskoye Pieriemiriye, also sometimes known as Treaty of Andrusovo) established a thirteen-and-a-half year truce, signed on 9 February [O.S. 30 January] 1667 between the Tsardom of Russia and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which had fought the Russo-Polish War since 1654. Afanasy Ordin-Nashchokin (for Russia) and Jerzy Chlebowicz (for the Commonwealth) signed the truce in the village of Andrusovo not far from Smolensk.

zh.t: 安德鲁索沃停战协定签署，结束俄波战争
zh.s: 安德鲁索沃停战协定（波兰语：Rozejm w Andruszowie；俄语：Андрусовское перемирие，Andrusovskoye Pieriemiriye，也称安德鲁索沃条约）规定俄罗斯沙皇国与波兰立陶宛联邦停战十三年半。两国自1654年起交战。1667年1月30日（儒略历2月9日），双方在斯摩棱斯克附近的安德鲁索沃村签署协定，俄方代表为阿法纳西·奥尔金-纳什乔金，联邦代表为耶日·赫勒比维奇。

en.s: The Luso–Maratha War was a military conflict fought between the Portuguese and the Maratha Empires, initiated by the Marathas invading and raiding Portuguese-controlled villages near the walled city of Damaon.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 葡萄牙—马拉塔战争是葡萄牙帝国与马拉塔帝国之间的军事冲突。战争由马拉塔人入侵并袭击葡萄牙控制的达曼城附近村庄引发。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: On January 30, 1806, the original Lower Trenton Bridge opened across the Delaware River between Trenton, New Jersey, and Morrisville, Pennsylvania, United States. The current bridge replaced it in 1928; the well-known slogan sign was added later.

zh.s: 1806年1月30日，原下特伦顿大桥通车，横跨美国特拉华河，连接新泽西州特伦顿和宾夕法尼亚州莫里斯维尔。现桥于1928年取代旧桥，知名的标语牌是后来加上的。

en.s: On 30 January 1820, Edward Bransfield sighted the Trinity Peninsula, the northern tip of the Antarctic mainland, after crossing the strait now named after him.
en.n: This records Bransfield’s sighting of the Trinity Peninsula, not an uncontested claim to be the first person to discover all of Antarctica.

zh.t: 布兰斯菲尔德发现三一半岛
zh.s: 1820年1月30日，爱德华·布兰斯菲尔德穿过如今以他命名的海峡后，望见南极大陆北端的三一半岛。
zh.n: 此条记录布兰斯菲尔德望见三一半岛，不将其表述为没有争议的“首次发现南极洲”。

en.t: Richard Lawrence became the first person to attempt to assassinate a sitting US president when he failed to kill Andrew Jackson at the US Capitol (assassination attempt pictured) and was subdued by the crowd
en.s: Richard Lawrence (c. 1800 – June 13, 1861) was a British-born American unemployed house painter who was the first known person to attempt the assassination of a sitting president of the United States. Lawrence attempted to shoot President Andrew Jackson outside the United States Capitol on January 30, 1835, however both of his pistols misfired and he was taken into custody.

zh.t: 理查德·劳伦斯成为首位试图刺杀在任美国总统的人；他在国会大厦外行刺安德鲁·杰克逊未遂，被人群制服
zh.s: 理查德·劳伦斯（约1800年—1861年6月13日）是一名出生于英国的美国失业房屋油漆工，也是已知首位试图刺杀在任美国总统的人。1835年1月30日，劳伦斯在美国国会大厦外试图枪击总统安德鲁·杰克逊，但他的两把手枪都没有击发，随后被拘捕。

en.t: 1852 United States Senate special election in California
en.s: The 1852 United States Senate special election in California was held on January 30, 1852, by the California State Legislature to elect a U.S. senator (Class 1) to represent the State of California in the United States Senate. Legislators had previously attempted to elect a Senator in 1851, but could not reach a majority for a single candidate. In a special joint session, former Democratic Congressman from Ohio John B.

zh.t: 1852年加利福尼亚州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1852年1月30日，加利福尼亚州议会举行联邦参议员特别选举，选出代表该州的第一组联邦参议员。州议员此前曾于1851年尝试选举，但没有任何一名候选人获得多数支持。原文接着提到一次特别联席会议及来自俄亥俄州的前民主党联邦众议员约翰·B.，但在此处中断，未提供完整姓名或后续内容。

Walker did not run for re-election. Former U.S. representative Charles Durkee was elected United States senator on the eighth ballot, and became the first Republican U.S. senator from Wisconsin. zh.t: 1855年威斯康星州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1855年1月30日至2月1日，第八届威斯康星州议会举行联邦参议员选举。民主党现任参议员艾萨克·P.沃克未寻求连任。前联邦众议员查尔斯·德基在第八轮投票中当选，成为威斯康星州首位共和党联邦参议员。原文末尾另有一句在“This was the first U.S.”处中断。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 30 January 1856. Rafael Campo ran unopposed and was elected by the citizenry, the first popular election in Salvadoran history.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于1856年1月30日举行总统选举。拉斐尔·坎波在没有竞争对手的情况下由公民选出，这是萨尔瓦多历史上首次民众投票选举。

en.s: On January 30, 1863, Union and Confederate forces fought the Battle of Deserted House near Suffolk, Virginia, United States, during the American Civil War. Union troops drove the Confederates back.

zh.s: 1863年1月30日，美国内战期间，南北双方军队在弗吉尼亚州萨福克附近展开废屋之战，北军将南军击退。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 30 January 1872. Santiago González ran unopposed and was elected by the legislature.

zh.s: 萨尔瓦多于1872年1月30日举行总统选举。圣地亚哥·冈萨雷斯在没有竞争对手的情况下由议会选为总统。

en.t: Archduke Crown Prince Rudolf of Austria, heir to the Austro-Hungarian crown, is found dead with his mistress Baroness Mary Vetsera in the Mayerling
en.s: Rudolf, Crown Prince of Austria (Rudolf Franz Karl Josef; 21 August 1858 – 30 January 1889) was the only son and third child of Emperor Franz Joseph I and Empress Elisabeth of Austria. He was heir apparent to the imperial throne of the Austro-Hungarian Empire from birth. In 1889, he died in a suicide pact with his mistress Baroness Mary Vetsera at the Mayerling hunting lodge.

zh.t: 奥地利皇储鲁道夫大公与情妇玛丽·韦策拉男爵夫人被发现死于迈耶林
zh.s: 奥地利皇储鲁道夫大公（鲁道夫·弗朗茨·卡尔·约瑟夫，1858年8月21日—1889年1月30日）是弗朗茨·约瑟夫一世皇帝和奥地利皇后伊丽莎白的独子，也是他们的第三个孩子。他自出生起就是奥匈帝国皇位继承人。1889年，他与情妇玛丽·韦策拉男爵夫人在迈耶林狩猎小屋以自杀殉情。

en.s: The Anglo-Japanese Alliance (日英同盟, Nichi-Ei Dōmei) was an alliance between the United Kingdom and the Empire of Japan which was effective from 1902 to 1923. The treaty creating the alliance was signed at Lansdowne House in London on 30 January 1902 by British foreign secretary Henry Petty-Fitzmaurice, 5th Marquess of Lansdowne and Japanese diplomat Hayashi Tadasu.

zh.s: 英日同盟是英国与日本帝国之间的同盟，1902年至1923年间有效。1902年1月30日，英国外交大臣第五代兰斯当侯爵亨利·佩蒂-菲茨莫里斯与日本外交官林董在伦敦兰斯当府签署了建立同盟的条约。

en.s: The Odessa Bolshevik uprising (Ukrainian: Одеське січневе збройне повстання) was a Bolshevik-led uprising of workers and sailors in Odessa against the government of Ukrainian People's Republic. The rebels were supported by approaching Red Guards forces of Soviet Russia.

zh.s: 敖德萨布尔什维克起义是由布尔什维克领导的工人和水兵起义，反抗乌克兰人民共和国政府。来自苏俄、正在逼近的赤卫队也支持起义者。

zh.t: 波兰—捷克斯洛伐克战争
zh.s: 捷克斯洛伐克—波兰战争在捷克资料中通常称为“七日战争”，是1919年初捷克斯洛伐克与波兰围绕切申西里西亚地区发生的军事冲突。

en.t: Japanese carmaker Mazda is founded, initially as a cork-producing company
en.s: Mazda Motor Corporation (マツダ株式会社, Matsuda Kabushiki gaisha) is a Japanese multinational automotive manufacturer headquartered in Fuchū, Hiroshima, Japan. The company was founded on January 30, 1920, as Toyo Cork Kogyo Co., Ltd., a cork-making factory, by Jujiro Matsuda. The company then acquired Abemaki Tree Cork Company. It changed its name to Toyo Kogyo Co., Ltd. in 1927 and started producing vehicles in 1931.

zh.t: 日本汽车制造商马自达创立，最初是一家软木制造企业
zh.s: 马自达株式会社是一家总部位于日本广岛县府中町的跨国汽车制造商。1920年1月30日，松田重次郎创办东洋软木工业株式会社，最初是一家软木制品工厂。公司随后收购了阿部软木制造所，1927年更名为东洋工业株式会社，并于1931年开始生产汽车。

en.t: Soviet Politburo adopts a dekulakization resolution
en.s: On 30 January 1930, the Soviet Communist Party Politburo adopted a resolution on eliminating kulak households in areas undergoing comprehensive collectivization. It divided those targeted into three categories and provided for repression, deportation and dispossession.

zh.t: 苏联政治局通过“消灭富农”决议
zh.s: 1930年1月30日，苏联共产党中央政治局通过决议，要求在全面集体化地区“消灭富农户”。决议将针对的农户分为三类，规定了镇压、流放和剥夺财产等措施。

en.s: On 30 January 1933, President Paul von Hindenburg appointed Adolf Hitler chancellor of Germany. The new cabinet was sworn in at Hindenburg’s office in Berlin.

zh.t: 希特勒被任命为德国总理
zh.s: 1933年1月30日，德国总统保罗·冯·兴登堡任命希特勒为总理，新内阁在柏林兴登堡的办公室宣誓就职。

en.t: Hitler threatens European Jews in a Reichstag speech
en.s: On 30 January 1939, Adolf Hitler threatened the annihilation of European Jews if another world war occurred, in a speech to the Reichstag in Berlin, Germany. Nazi leaders later repeatedly cited the threat in their propaganda.

zh.t: 希特勒在国会演讲中威胁欧洲犹太人
zh.s: 1939年1月30日，希特勒在德国柏林向国会发表演讲，威胁说，若再次爆发世界大战，欧洲犹太人将遭到灭绝。纳粹领导人后来多次在宣传中引用这番威胁。

en.s: Convoy HX 106 was the 106th of the numbered series of Allied HX convoys of merchant ships from Halifax, Nova Scotia to Liverpool, England. Forty-one ships departed Halifax, Nova Scotia on 30 January 1941, eastbound to Liverpool, England. The use of convoys was a standard tactic throughout the Battle of the Atlantic as a defence against U-boats and German commerce raiders.

zh.s: HX 106号船队是盟军HX系列商船船队中的第106支，从加拿大新斯科舍省哈利法克斯驶往英格兰利物浦。1941年1月30日，41艘船从哈利法克斯启航，向东驶往利物浦。在大西洋海战期间，船队是防御德国潜艇和袭商船队的一种常用战术。

en.s: The Battle of Ambon (30 January – 3 February 1942) occurred on Ambon Island in the Dutch East Indies (now Indonesia), as part of the Japanese offensive on the Dutch colony during World War II. In the face of a combined defense by Dutch and Australian troops, Japanese forces conquered the island and its strategic airfield in several days.

en.s: The Battle of Rennell Island (Japanese: レンネル島沖海戦, Hepburn: Renneru-shima oki kaisen) took place on 29–30 January 1943. It was the last major naval engagement between the United States Navy and the Imperial Japanese Navy during the Guadalcanal campaign of World War II. It occurred in the South Pacific between Rennell Island and Guadalcanal in the southern Solomon Islands.

zh.s: 克拉斯诺耶谢洛—罗普沙攻势又称“雷霆行动”或“涅瓦河二号行动”，是苏联列宁格勒方面军与德国第18集团军之间的一场战役，发生于1944年1月14日至30日，争夺列宁格勒西侧的通道。

en.s: The Raid at Cabanatuan, also known as The Great Raid, was a rescue of Allied prisoners of war (POWs) and civilians from a Japanese camp near Cabanatuan City, in the Philippines. On January 30, 1945, during World War II, United States Army Rangers, Alamo Scouts, and Filipino guerrillas liberated more than 500 from the POW camp. After the surrender of tens of thousands of American troops during the Battle of Bataan, many were sent to the Cabanatuan prison camp following the Bataan Death March. The Japanese transferred most of the prisoners to other areas, leaving just over 500 American and other Allied POWs and civilians in the prison.

zh.s: 卡巴那图突袭又称大营救，是从菲律宾卡巴那图市附近的日军营地中营救盟军战俘和平民的行动。二战期间的1945年1月30日，美国陆军游骑兵、阿拉莫侦察兵和菲律宾游击队从该战俘营救出500多人。此前，数万名美军在巴丹战役中投降，许多人经历巴丹死亡行军后被关入卡巴那图战俘营。日军后来将大部分战俘转移到别处，仅留下500多名美国及其他盟军战俘和平民。

en.s: Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi, better known as Mahatma Gandhi, was assassinated at the Birla House (now Gandhi Smriti) in New Delhi on 30 January 1948. Gandhi was outside on the steps where a prayer meeting was going to take place, surrounded by a part of his family and some followers, when Nathuram Godse, a Hindu nationalist and prominent member of Hindu Mahasabha, approached and shot him three times in the chest at close range.

zh.s: 1948年1月30日，通常被称为圣雄甘地的莫罕达斯·卡拉姆昌德·甘地，在新德里比拉宅邸、即今天的甘地纪念馆遇刺。当时他站在室外台阶上，准备参加祈祷会，身边围着部分家人和追随者。印度教民族主义者、印度教大斋会重要成员纳图拉姆·戈德塞走近他，近距离向其胸部连开三枪。

en.s: Star Tiger (registration G-AHNP) was an Avro Tudor passenger aircraft owned and operated by British South American Airways (BSAA) which disappeared without a trace over the Atlantic Ocean while on a flight between Santa Maria in the Azores and Bermuda in the early morning of 30 January 1948. The loss of the aircraft, along with that of BSAA Avro Tudor Star Ariel in 1949, remains unsolved.

zh.t: 英国南美航空“星虎号”失踪
zh.s: “星虎号”（注册号G-AHNP）是一架由英国南美航空拥有并运营的阿夫罗·都铎客机。1948年1月30日清晨，飞机从亚速尔群岛圣玛丽亚岛飞往百慕大途中，在大西洋上空失踪，未留下任何踪迹。英国南美航空另一架阿夫罗·都铎客机“星座号”也于1949年失踪；这两起事故至今未解。

en.t: SAS occupies Saiq and Shuraijah in Oman
en.s: On 30 January 1959, British SAS troops occupied Saiq and Shuraijah on Jebel Akhdar in Oman. Little further resistance followed, and rebel leaders went into exile or dispersed.
en.n: This records the occupation of Saiq and Shuraijah, a specific dated final phase of the Jebel Akhdar War.

zh.t: 英军占领阿曼赛克和舒赖贾
zh.s: 1959年1月30日，英国特种空勤团占领阿曼绿山地区的赛克和舒赖贾，此后几乎未再遇到抵抗，叛军领导人流亡，其他人员分散撤离。

en.t: Danish ocean liner MS Hans Hedtoft sank, resulting in the deaths of all 95 passengers and crew
en.s: MS Hans Hedtoft was a Danish cargo passenger liner that struck an iceberg and sank on 30 January 1959 on her maiden voyage off the coast of Western Greenland. The only piece of the wreckage found was a lifebelt.

zh.t: 丹麦客轮“汉斯·赫托夫特号”沉没，船上95名乘客和船员全部遇难
zh.s: “汉斯·赫托夫特号”是一艘丹麦客货轮。1959年1月30日，首航途中，船只在格陵兰西海岸附近撞上冰山后沉没。后来只找到一只救生圈。

en.t: The African National Party is founded in Chad, through the merger of traditionalist parties
en.s: The African National Party (French: Parti national africain, PNA) was a political party in Chad. PNA was founded on January 30, 1960, through the merger of remnants of four parties based in the Muslim-dominated northern Chad; African Socialist Movement, Chadian Social Action, Independent Democratic Union of Chad and Grouping of Rural and Independent Chadians.

zh.t: 乍得非洲民族党成立，传统主义政党合并组建
zh.s: 非洲民族党（法语：Parti national africain，简称PNA）是乍得的一个政党。该党于1960年1月30日成立，由乍得北部四个政党的残余力量合并而成。这四个政党分别是非洲社会主义运动、乍得社会行动党、乍得独立民主联盟和农村及独立乍得人联盟。

en.s: Before dawn on January 30, 1964, General Nguyễn Khánh ousted the military junta led by General Dương Văn Minh from the leadership of South Vietnam without firing a shot. It came less than three months after Minh's junta had themselves come to power in a bloody coup against then President Ngô Đình Diệm. The coup took less than a few hours.

en.s: The Tet Offensive was both a major escalation and one of the largest military campaigns of the Vietnam War. The North Vietnamese People's Army of Vietnam (PAVN) and the Viet Cong (VC) launched a surprise attack on 30 and 31 January 1968 against the forces of the South Vietnamese Army of the Republic of Vietnam (ARVN), the United States Armed Forces and their allies, targeting military and civilian command and control centers throughout South Vietnam.
en.n: Vietnam War: Tet Offensive launch by forces of the Viet Cong and North Vietnamese Army against South Vietnam, the United States, and their allies.

en.s: On 30 January 1969, the Beatles performed a concert from the rooftop of their Apple Corps headquarters at 3 Savile Row, in central London's office and fashion district. Joined by guest keyboardist Billy Preston, the band played a 42-minute set before the Metropolitan Police arrived and told them to reduce the volume. It was the final public performance of their career.

zh.s: 1969年1月30日，披头士乐队在伦敦市中心萨维尔街3号苹果唱片公司总部的屋顶上演出。键盘手比利·普雷斯顿作为嘉宾参加，乐队演奏了42分钟，直到伦敦警察厅的警员赶到并要求他们调低音量。这是乐队最后一次公开演出。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Madagascar on 30 January 1972. Incumbent President Philibert Tsiranana of the Social Democratic Party was the only candidate, and won the approval of 99.7% of voters. However, public unrest led to him handing over power to General Gabriel Ramanantsoa. Ramanantsoa put forward proposals for a five-year transition period during which the National Assembly would be suspended.

zh.s: 马达加斯加于1972年1月30日举行总统选举。社会民主党现任总统菲利贝尔·齐拉纳纳是唯一候选人，获得99.7%的选民支持。不过，民众动荡迫使他将权力交给加布里埃尔·拉马南佐阿将军。拉马南佐阿提出实行五年过渡期，并在此期间暂停国民议会运作。

en.s: On 30 January 1972, British soldiers opened fire on unarmed civilians during an anti-internment march in Derry, Northern Ireland, United Kingdom. Thirteen men were killed that day; another wounded man died months later.

zh.s: 1972年1月30日，英国军人在北爱尔兰德里向参加反对未经审判拘禁游行的无武装平民开枪，13名男子当日死亡，另有一名伤者数月后去世。

en.s: Campaign Z (17 December 1971 – 30 January 1972) was a military offensive by the People's Army of Vietnam; it was a combined arms thrust designed to defeat the last Royal Lao Army troops defending the Kingdom of Laos. The Communist assault took Skyline Ridge overlooking the vital Royalist base of Long Tieng and forced the restationing of Royalist aviation assets and civilian refugees.

en.s: Pan Am Flight 806 was an international scheduled flight from Auckland, New Zealand, to Los Angeles, California, with intermediate stops at Pago Pago, American Samoa and Honolulu, Hawaii. On January 30, 1974, the Boeing 707 Clipper Radiant crashed on approach to Pago Pago International Airport, killing 87 passengers and ten crew members, making it the deadliest aviation incident in American Samoan history.

zh.s: 泛美航空806号班机是从新西兰奥克兰飞往美国加利福尼亚州洛杉矶的国际定期航班，中途经停美属萨摩亚帕果帕果及夏威夷檀香山。1974年1月30日，执行该航班的“光辉快船”号波音707飞机在接近帕果帕果国际机场时坠毁，造成87名乘客和十名机组成员死亡，是美属萨摩亚历史上死亡人数最多的航空事故。

en.s: Turkish Airlines Flight 345 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight operated by a Fokker F28-1000 Fellowship from İzmir Cumaovası Airport to Istanbul Yeşilköy Airport that crashed into the Sea of Marmara on 30 January 1975 during approach. It was the second worst accident involving a Fokker F28 and third deadliest aviation accident in Turkey at that time.

zh.s: 土耳其航空345号班机是一趟定期国内客运航班，由福克F28-1000“友谊”型客机执飞，往返伊兹密尔库马奥瓦瑟机场和伊斯坦布尔耶希尔科伊机场。1975年1月30日，飞机在进近时坠入马尔马拉海。那是当时福克F28机型事故中伤亡第二严重、土耳其航空事故中死亡人数第三多的一起。

en.s: Varig Flight 967 was an international cargo flight from Narita International Airport in Japan to Rio de Janeiro–Galeão International Airport in Brazil, with a stopover at Los Angeles International Airport in the United States. On 30 January 1979, the Boeing 707 serving the flight disappeared while en route to Los Angeles with radio contact being lost an hour into the flight.

zh.s: 巴西航空967号班机是一趟国际货运航班，从日本成田国际机场飞往巴西里约热内卢加利昂国际机场，中途经停美国洛杉矶国际机场。1979年1月30日，执飞该航班的波音707客机在飞往洛杉矶途中失踪，起飞约一小时后与地面失去无线电联系。

en.s: Local elections for governors, vice governors, mayors and vice mayors in the nation's first elections for provincial and municipal officials since the declaration of martial law were held on January 30, 1980. As usual, President Ferdinand Marcos's party the Kilusang Bagong Lipunan dominated the elections. The Lakas ng Bayan and the Liberal Party-backed National Union for Liberation did participate but most of them lost except for some like Aquilino Pimentel, Jr. who won the mayoral election in Cagayan de Oro City by a landslide.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1980年1月30日举行省长、副省长、市长和副市长选举。这是全国宣布戒严后首次选举省级和市镇官员。费迪南德·马科斯总统的新社会运动党一如既往地主导选举。人民力量党以及自由党支持的全国解放联盟也参加了选举，但多数候选人落败。少数例外包括小阿基利诺·皮门特尔，他以压倒性优势赢得卡加延德奥罗市长选举。

en.s: Operation Beanbag, also known as the Matola Raid, was a military operation conducted by the South African Defence Force (SADF) against suspected safe houses of uMkhonto we Sizwe (MK), armed wing of the African National Congress (ANC), in Matola, Mozambique. The operation was authorised by Prime Minister P.W. Botha.

zh.s: “豆袋行动”（又称马托拉突袭）是南非国防军针对莫桑比克马托拉疑似安全屋实施的一次军事行动。目标是非洲人国民大会武装组织民族之矛的据点。行动经总理P·W·博塔批准。

en.s: The 1981 Charity Shield was the first Charity Shield (NSL), a soccer match played between the winners of the previous season's National Soccer League champion and NSL Cup winner. It took place at Redfern Oval on 30 January 1981, between Sydney City and Marconi Fairfield. Marconi Fairfield won 3–1 after extra time, winning the first Charity Shield.

zh.s: 1981年慈善盾杯是首届国家足球联赛慈善盾杯，由上赛季国家足球联赛冠军对阵联赛杯冠军。比赛于1981年1月30日在雷德芬椭圆球场举行，由悉尼城队对阵马可尼费尔菲尔德队。马可尼费尔菲尔德队在加时赛后以3比1获胜，赢得首届慈善盾杯。

en.t: Iraqi and US fighters clash in Operation Samurra
en.s: On 30 January 1991, during the Gulf War, Iraqi MiG-25 interceptors engaged US Air Force F-15 fighters over Iraq in Operation Samurra.

en.s: The 1993 Copa Centenario de la AFA Final was a football match played on January 30, 1994, between Gimnasia y Esgrima La Plata and River Plate to determine the Copa Centenario de la AFA champion. The match was played at Gimnasia y Esgrima's venue, Estadio Juan Carmelo Zerillo in La Plata. Gimnasia y Esgrima was managed by Roberto Perfumo after the coach team composed by Carlos Ramaciotti and Edgardo Sbrissa resigned after five rounds played.

zh.s: 1993年阿根廷足协百年杯决赛于1994年1月30日举行，由拉普拉塔体操击剑俱乐部对阵河床队，决出赛事冠军。比赛在拉普拉塔体操击剑俱乐部的主场胡安·卡梅洛·塞里约球场举行。卡洛斯·拉马乔蒂和埃德加多·斯布里萨组成的教练组执教五轮后辞职，罗伯托·佩尔富莫接手球队。

en.t: 1995 Liberal Party of Australia leadership spill
en.s: A leadership spill of the federal parliamentary leader of the Liberal Party of Australia was held on 30 January 1995 after the resignation of Alexander Downer following several months of poor personal ratings for him. John Howard was elected unopposed in a vote of Liberal Party Members of Parliament. Howard thus became the Leader of the Opposition in the Parliament of Australia. Peter Costello remained deputy leader.

zh.t: 1995年澳大利亚自由党领袖选举
zh.s: 亚历山大·唐纳辞职后，澳大利亚自由党于1995年1月30日改选联邦议会党团领袖。此前几个月，他的个人支持率一直不佳。约翰·霍华德在自由党议员投票中无人竞争，当选领袖，并成为澳大利亚议会反对党领袖。彼得·科斯特洛继续担任副领袖。

en.t: United States Senate special election in Oregon, 1996
en.s: The 1996 United States Senate special election in Oregon was held on January 30, 1996 to fill the seat vacated by Republican Bob Packwood, who had resigned from the Senate due to sexual misconduct allegations. In the primaries held on December 5, 1995, Democratic U. S. Representative Ron Wyden and Republican President of the Oregon State Senate Gordon H. Smith were nominated. Wyden then defeated Smith in the general election. Smith would win the regularly-scheduled election to the Senate later that year and serve alongside Wyden until 2009.

zh.t: 1996年俄勒冈州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 俄勒冈州于1996年1月30日举行联邦参议员特别选举，填补共和党人鲍勃·帕克伍德因性行为不当指控辞职后留下的空缺。在1995年12月5日的初选中，民主党联邦众议员罗恩·怀登和共和党俄勒冈州参议院议长戈登·H.史密斯分别获得提名，随后怀登在正式选举中击败史密斯。史密斯在同年稍后举行的例行参议员选举中获胜，与怀登一同在参议院任职，直至2009年。

en.s: The Tenang state by-election was a state by-election that was held on 30 January 2011 in the state of Johor, Malaysia. The nomination of candidates was done on 22 January 2011. en.s: The Hampstead and Kilburn Conservative Party parliamentary primary of 2013 was the 1st open primary election used to select the Conservative Prospective Parliamentary Candidate for the constituency of Hampstead and Kilburn. The election was held on Wednesday 30 January 2013 under the first-past-the-post system. It was the third primary organised by a Conservative Association to select a PPC, after Totnes and Gosport. The seat is also held by a Labour MP and is the Conservatives' number one target seat at the next election.

zh.t: 第54届鹿特丹国际电影节
zh.s: 第54届鹿特丹国际电影节是2025年举办的一届鹿特丹国际电影节，于2025年1月30日至2月9日举行。入围影片完整名单于2024年12月17日公布。电影节以米希尔·滕霍恩执导的荷兰电影《Fabula》开幕，并于2月9日闭幕，闭幕影片是穆莉·苏莉娅编剧并执导的印度尼西亚战争剧情片《这座城市是一片战场》。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的开幕日期。
